items.raw_excerpt: The website WE NEWS has three northern Indigenous 'AI correspondents.' Their profiles say they are 'a member of Yukon First Nation,' 'of Dene heritage,' and 'an Inuk raised in the North.' Experts in the industry call the site disturbing and say it muddies the waters for readers trying to get authentic information.
items.summary_en: A website called WE NEWS shows three northern Indigenous 'AI correspondents' made by artificial intelligence. Their profiles say they are members of Yukon First Nation, of Dene heritage, and an Inuk raised in the North. Experts say the site is harmful and confuses readers who want real news.
items.summary_ko: WE NEWS라는 웹사이트는 인공지능으로 만든 세 명의 북부 원주민 'AI 기자'를 보여 준다. 기자 소개에는 유콘 원주민, 데네 출신, 북부에서 자란 이누크라는 설명이 적혀 있다. 업계 전문가들은 이 사이트가 해롭고, 진짜 정보를 얻고자 하는 독자들을 혼란스럽게 한다고 말한다.
items.title_en: Website uses AI to make fake northern Indigenous news reporters

items.raw_excerpt: En el informe de Cooperativa Deportes, supimos que Azul Azul inició una gestión encabezada por el director Aldo Marín y el asesor Mauricio Etcheverry para solicitar a Conmebol la anulación o aplazamiento del castigo que restan de cuatro partidos sin público tras los incidentes con Independiente de Avellaneda en octavos de la Copa Sudamericana 2025, pensando en la posible disputa de torneos internacionales durante el próximo año, el de su centenario.
items.summary_en: The soccer club Universidad de Chile asked Conmebol to cancel or delay the remaining four-match ban on games without fans. The ban followed incidents with Independiente de Avellaneda in the 2025 Copa Sudamericana. The club wants it fixed before possible international games next year, its centennial year.

items.raw_excerpt: Some George Gordon First Nation members are questioning the long-term implications of Bell's AI data centre expansion near Regina.
